forecasts.interpretation: repeat the 168-hour forecast cyclically for every one of four simulated scheduling scenarios, not real/observed subsequent-week carbon intensity
forecasts.planning_signal: fixed arithmetic mean per resource over the 336-row NESO week
forecasts.optimizer_iteration_carbon_mapping: disabled in v2 mode; no artificial time advancement per optimizer iteration
forecasts.planning_constraint_semantics: carbon class thresholds apply to fixed per-region week-mean forecast intensity; not a guarantee of threshold compliance at every job execution instant
forecasts.objective_semantics: time-integrated GPU-side energy-weighted forecast carbon intensity across the simulated job execution intervals
forecasts.replay_assumption: fixed full-week forecasts available to an offline counterfactual scheduler; not a real-time production scheduling demonstration

selection_rationale: Alibaba v2023 mean modeled makespan is approximately 308 hours, exceeding the 168-hour frozen forecast. A consistent explicit periodic replay is a controlled counterfactual assumption across all scenarios.
carbon_objective: modeled GPU-side time-integrated energy-weighted forecast intensity in gCO2e/kWh
additional_reporting_metric: modelled total carbon exposure grams CO2e from energy x time-varying intensity
remaining_limitations: full 13-algorithm integration smoke tests are committed but not executed in the complete repository checkout
aggregate CPU enforcement is implemented on the validation branch, but full-repository regression and real-trace pilot remain unexecuted
fixed region-mean planning constraints are not guaranteed per-execution-interval carbon limits
no complete 13 algorithm x 30 seeds x 4 scenarios carbon-v2 experiment results
original traces are not historical measurements of UK regional electricity use
workload-activity-based GPU-side power excludes inactive idle and host power
EBWS remains unexercised because recorded dependencies are absent
selected forecast period may not be representative of different seasonal intensity
publication_gate: Requires coauthor approval of offline counterfactual model and periodic replay assumption, end-to-end tests, one real-trace pilot, full corrected cohort, statistical analysis, and regenerated manuscript results.
